j.brief_text: We are comparing two staffing options, labelled exactly "Keep current staffing" and "Add one specialist". Use the exact goal label "Weekly support capacity". Our existing team resolves 80 tickets per week. Keep current staffing adds no specialist. Add one specialist adds one specialist. Each additional specialist resolves about 20 tickets per week, between 10 and 30. Total weekly support capacity is defined as the existing 80 tickets per week plus the additional specialist capacity. Goal: weekly support capacity of at least 100 tickets per week. This target is an absolute level, with no deadline.

conversation_turns.assistant_message:
I’ve built the comparison around **Weekly support capacity**, with the target **at least 100 tickets per week** and no deadline.

- **Keep current staffing** holds today’s capacity at 80 tickets per week.
- **Add one specialist** uses your stated central estimate of **20 tickets per week per specialist**, with your stated range of **10–30**.
- Capacity is modelled as **80 + additional specialist capacity**.
- I also included **Add two specialists** as an Olumi-proposed comparison option; it has not been confirmed by you.

A provisional first pass was run automatically on this newly drafted model. It is based on unconfirmed model readings and should be treated as something to challenge, not an answer or a basis for choosing.

The key uncertainty is whether one specialist can sustain the stated 20-ticket weekly central estimate; the 10–30 range crosses the amount needed to reach the target.

‘Add two specialists’ is Olumi’s suggestion, so it was left out of this comparison until you add it.

Olumi's estimates: 6, see Check estimates.
